Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 56: the slip of [[Blizzard 2 (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“May add 1 pilot and 8 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. During your control phase, may ▲ one Trample or Walker Barrage. Walker Barrage total is +2. Immune to attrition < 4.”), word for word the text of [[Blizzard 2 (V) (Virtual Block 2)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
